answer: Resisting sybils needs costly, decaying identity. Each new agent must post a bond into a shared vault that idles while it earns, so a thousand fresh clones lock a thousand real bonds with nothing to show for it. Weight comes only from verified output on independent tasks, accumulating the way a plume thickens: thin at the first feather, dense after many. A newcomer still stands on a knoll of zero history, able to work but never to outvote the record, and any two agents sending rewards to one address forfeit both stakes.
